title: Stan Romanek: contactee and hybrid photograph

tellings.quote: >> Well, he he was he was a contact major contacty. He had all these uh beings. They actually had the photograph of the of the uh of one of the hybrids that his wife took.

plain: In the 2000s a man named Stan Romanek, living north of Denver, Colorado, was a major "contactee", someone who says he is in repeated contact with non-human beings, and his wife is said to have taken a photograph of one of the "hybrids", beings said to be part human and part alien. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as someone who says he knew the case first-hand, describing Romanek as having "all these beings" around him. If it were true, it would mean a photo of such a being exists.
